title: Joint longitudinal observation likelihood: frozen synthetic software contract
freeze_condition: Commit and pin this protocol and register all numeric inputs before evaluating the new synthetic fixture or its diagnostics. No calculated fixture outputs are included.

design_trace.scope: Health observation likelihood only; dietary F-04 and economic feedback remain separately evidence-blocked.

numeric_input_guard: Exact frozen parameter key/value/unit/status/grade/role agreement before calculation; finite-difference and probability controls are numerical only, not sourced clinical tolerances or uncertainty distributions.

state_meanings.N: Arbitrary lower glycemic label without diagnosed-T2D history
state_meanings.P: Arbitrary higher glycemic label without diagnosed-T2D history
state_meanings.D: Arbitrary higher glycemic label with diagnosed-T2D history
state_meanings.R: Arbitrary improved/lower glycemic label with diagnosed-T2D history retained; not validated untreated remission
state_meanings.death: Separate absorbing death destination, not a missing assessment

state_space.diagonal_rule: negative sum of every outgoing off-diagonal rate, including competing death
state_space.forbidden_transitions: Any transition out of death, or from D/R back to N/P; no diagnosed-history erasure

software_validation.entry_distribution_rule: Point mass on the explicitly supplied toy entry state; no inferred clinical allocation

emissions.membership_rule: Deterministic categorical emission: one for state membership, zero otherwise. These are structural toy definitions, not empirical test sensitivity or specificity.
emissions.set_valued_rule: Sum the disjoint declared categorical operators; no unknown or missing test is automatically mapped to the whole alphabet
emissions.history_rule: The fixture builder supplies emission vectors intersected with its assessed history masks; retain an earlier positive history when later history is not assessed. Core API has no raw history_report field. A contrary no-history mask after positive history has no compatible path and contributes zero, not a repaired recovery state.

panel_likelihood.formula: alpha * chronological_product[exp(Q_segment * duration) * E_observation * history_mask] * ones, splitting propagation at every regime boundary
panel_likelihood.scaling: Scale each positive forward update and accumulate log scales; exact zero contribution is negative infinity with JSON null/status, never a finite substituted floor
panel_likelihood.categorical_partition: All declared observation categories exhaust the supplied state space; observed sets sum their disjoint category contributions
panel_likelihood.treatment_interpretation: Condition on the supplied piecewise regime; no causal treatment-assignment model or dietary effect
panel_likelihood.event_timing_from_history_mask: A history observation constrains compatibility at its visit, not an exact first-event time

first_entry.event_equality_status: synthetic assumption; not a statement about clinical diagnosis versus biological onset
first_entry.killed_diagonals: Retain negative total outgoing hazards of the full generator, including both removed terminal destinations
first_entry.piecewise_segments: Use the same A/B clock boundaries and rate override as the panel fixture, including inside a terminal event interval
first_entry.exact_formula: alpha propagated by killed segment kernels to t, multiplied by the event hazard vector at t; output density per year
first_entry.interval_formula: Integrate the killed-process event density over [lower,upper], accounting for survival into each intersected segment; output probability
first_entry.right_censor_formula: alpha propagated by killed segment kernels through the supported event-ascertainment time, summed over transient states; no event and alive
first_entry.competing_death_formula: Separate killed-process density/integral using the competing-death hazard vector
first_entry.mass_identity: cumulative event probability + cumulative competing-death probability + transient survival = one
first_entry.integral_method: Augmented matrix exponential or independently verified stable equivalent, valid for singular/zero generators; no inverse-only formula
first_entry.segment_boundary_convention: Right-hand regime applies at an internal shared boundary; at the final schedule end use the last segment's left limit. A continuous-time boundary event has zero probability but exact-density convention is explicit.
first_entry.prefix_observations: Supported observed event-free prefix uses killed propagation and actual observation operators; no default last-negative proxy
first_entry.in_interval_observations: Initial implementation may reject additional observations inside the terminal event interval; silently discarding them is forbidden
first_entry.exact_death_after_full_panel: Use exact_first_entry with event/targets death only, retaining all four living transient states and any prior observed diagnosis history. Contribution is terminal death density, not terminal death occupancy probability.
first_entry.non_event_endpoint: Killed propagation jointly with supplied endpoint emission and history compatibility, summed over transient states; do not normalize by survival unless a separate explicit conditioning contract requires it

local_identification.model: Homogeneous segment A; segment B override is not a free parameter of this diagnostic
local_identification.finite_difference: Central differences with registered absolute step in each named hazard; reject a perturbation outside the declared nonnegative domain
local_identification.rank_rule: Count singular values greater than registered relative tolerance times the largest singular value; zero Jacobian has rank zero. Relative threshold is dimensionless; Jacobian entries have years units.

full_observable_design.full_rank_hypothesis: Nine at the frozen synthetic point; unexecuted hypothesis, not a source-identification claim

collapsed_design.dimension_rule: One scalar observable; rank at most one against nine free rates

report: relative tolerance and effective absolute cutoff

indistinguishable_scalar_alternative.comparison_model: Separately restricted N <-> P with all other edges zero; not the full five-state fixture

controls.stochastic_sampling_or_seed: No stochastic simulation needed for the frozen checks; probabilities and analytical identities only
controls.roundoff_correction: Disclose any correction of small negative matrix-exponential entries within the explicitly supplied probability tolerance. Reject larger violations; no generator/rate repair, positive likelihood floor or outcome-driven tolerance change.

input_contract.public_api_scope: Library-only StateSpace, RateSegment, PanelObservation, TerminalObservation and SoftwareObservationContract with explicit categorical operators; root owns audit registry/CLI integration

public_api_shapes.required_numerical_tolerance: Caller must supply a numerical tolerance; registered fixture uses longitudinal_probability_absolute_tolerance
public_api_shapes.path_likelihood: Supported linked panel prefix plus declared terminal mode under explicit known contract and piecewise segments

input_contract.immutability: Strict scalar types and immutable nested collections; detach from mutable caller inputs; reject duplicate observation times and inconsistent shapes. PanelObservation has no participant/observation identifier field.
input_contract.clock: One explicit origin and common declared time/rate units; finite supported times, ordered observations and contiguous nonoverlapping segments covering every used interval
input_contract.conversion: No automatic source-year/day conversion, unknown clock ordering or clinical annualization
input_contract.generator: Finite nonnegative allowed off-diagonal hazards, conservative negative diagonals and absorbing death; reject diagnosed-history erasure
input_contract.emission: Explicit finite nonnegative categorical probabilities with a normalized alphabet in each state; no guessed measurement-error parameters or clinical threshold mapping
input_contract.entry: Explicit probability weights and declared cohort conditioning; no universal prior-history or national state allocation
input_contract.unknowns: Unknown status is preserved; the evaluator rejects a dependent mode unless an explicit observation/coarsening contract justifies marginalization. An unassessed later history field cannot erase a previously assessed positive history.
input_contract.history: Diagnosis type, first positive, confirmation and recorded history remain distinct; no inferred untreated remission or biological onset. Core receives supplied emission vectors, not raw history fields. Contradictory masks have no compatible path and zero probability; they are never reassigned to an unrecorded recovery state.
input_contract.treatment: Known changes are declared regime boundaries; unknown treatment timing blocks treatment-dependent modes, and conditioning is not a causal adjustment claim
input_contract.visits_and_missingness: Exogenous/ignorable schedule must be explicitly justified for a future source; no default MAR, negative test, all-ones emission or independent censoring
input_contract.followup: Last glucose, last known alive contact, last event ascertainment and administrative end are distinct; event/death/censor contributions need explicit supported stopping semantics
input_contract.unsupported_source_mode: Reject without likelihood arithmetic, clinical fit or raw source disclosure; keep preservation/descriptive outputs under their existing contract

validation_plan: Match forward path probability to explicit enumeration of all compatible intermediate observation-state sequences
Verify categorical partition and set-valued observation sum without treating missing as an observed set
Check row mass, nonnegative probabilities, absorbing death and diagnosed-history preservation
Compare chronological segmented propagation with explicitly composed segment kernels; include treatment changes in event intervals
Verify exact first-event density, interval probability and right-censoring distinction, with cumulative event/death/survival mass identity
Check singular/zero-generator limits, zero-event hazards and impossible paths; retain negative infinity/status for zero likelihood
Verify exact death after a panel differs in meaning/units from endpoint death occupancy
Report full-design local Jacobian rank and scalar-design deficiency under the frozen numerical settings
Verify the closed-form restricted alternative matches the scalar endpoint but differs on full transition rows

Reject incompatible units, malformed types, duplicate observation times, uncovered segments and unsupported missingness/stopping; contradictory history masks must produce impossible zero paths, not a repaired positive probability
Verify no participant identifiers or raw path values enter public aggregate reports
Preserve active engine parameters, canonical numerical outputs and scientific-required failure

required_before_any_empirical_fit: linked compatible observations or sufficient joint aggregates
independently supported measurement-error terms or joint identification
identifiable supported-population parameters with joint uncertainty
frozen estimation/independent evaluation and transport plans

current_packages.Chen: Timing/version, treatment, post-diagnosis and competing-death gaps remain; no source eligibility from this kernel
current_packages.DPP: Normalized preservation fixture and public documentation do not supply verified permitted participant histories for clinical fitting
current_packages.Reus: First-diabetes regimen HR does not reconstruct risk sets, separate state hazards, consumed dose or lag
current_packages.PREVIEW: Selected endpoint/missingness and treatment/history information do not establish full clinical transition likelihood
current_packages.TOTUM: Public workbook raw-cell coverage is not verified participant pairing, clinical measurement/timing or treatment/death history
current_packages.Whitehall: Conditional terminal labels do not supply full interval histories, competing-death/selection model or annual hazards
current_packages.DiRECT: Composite failures and partial paired-label constraints lack observed assessment/death/missingness partition and actual clinical histories; no invented stochastic coarsening likelihood

failure_dispositions.invalid_math_or_input: No dependent contribution; sanitized failure, no fabricated likelihood or participant token leakage
failure_dispositions.numerical_identity_or_rank_failure: Retain frozen failure and diagnostics; no clipping, outcome-driven tolerance change or implicit repin
failure_dispositions.source_inadequacy_or_unknowns: Block dependent empirical fitting; preserve supported observations/descriptive outputs only
failure_dispositions.indistinguishable_parameters: Retain alternatives and unresolved quantities; no active coefficient or invented joint uncertainty
failure_dispositions.missing_independent_evaluation_or_transp: No scientific release or national engine activation
failure_dispositions.new_values_or_scope_required: Reviewed versioned amendment and registry update before new computation; original protocol remains immutable

report_contract.zero_likelihood_json: null numeric field with explicit impossible/negative_infinity status; no nonstandard JSON infinity or finite probability floor
